note: Authored humanoid rest pose in metres, feet on y=0, facing +Z. Bone names are a hard contract: src/atlas/render/three/character-bones.ts looks them up by exact authored name, character-gait-rig.ts drives the walk through hips/spine/chest/neck/head and the leg chains, and character-animation.ts drives facial cues through eye.L, eye.R, eyelid.L, eyelid.R and mouth. Renaming any of them breaks the renderer silently.
proportions: Six heads tall. Chin at 1.467 and crown at 1.760 give a 0.293 head, so 1.76 / 0.293 = 6.0. This replaces v1's 3.7-head chibi build, which was adopted only to keep a geometry-only face readable at small size; v2 carries facial detail in a texture instead, so the body no longer has to be stylised to compensate.

skinRadii.note: Per-joint radius fed to Blender's Skin modifier, in metres. These shape the body: the modifier grows continuous quad topology along the bone graph, which is why v2 has no visible intersections between separately placed ellipsoids the way v1 did.
